clause: c1 'Deal [Magic + 2] true damage to an enemy.' / c2 'Steal 3 Armor and shift it to Magic.'
step: native steps 3 (IncreaseSpellPower Self, counter) -> 4 (TrueDamage Amount 2, SpellPowerMultiplier 1)
expected: Native order: CountArmor(100%)->CountMax 3->DecreaseArmor->IncreaseSpellPower->TrueDamage, so the true damage uses the already-raised Magic: hp loss = (Magic + stolen) + 2 (target armor 5, stolen 3 -> Magic+5).
actual: Registered prototype runs damage first, then reduce(armor, gainStat magic): hp loss = Magic + 2 (old Magic). Armor steal amount (min(armor,3)) and Magic gain are correct.
note: English lists the damage sentence first but gives no explicit 'then'; the ordered native steps are the executing source. If fix prefers the English order, mark as source-dispute instead.

clause: c2 'There is a 10% chance to slay them, boosted by their Armor (up to 30%).'
step: native steps 0-2 (CountArmor 10%, CountMax 20, LethalDamageConditional Amount 10) execute BEFORE step 3 Damage and step 4 TroopOrderBack
expected: Slay chance = 10% + min(floor(preDamageArmor*10/100),20)%. Target armor 100, caster Magic 10 -> 20%; roll 0.19 slays.
actual: Prototype order is damage -> reposition -> execute; chanceBoost source targetStat(armor) is read after the [Magic+4] damage stripped armor (100->86) -> 18%; roll 0.19 does not slay. Base 10%, cap 30%, [Magic+4] damage and pull-to-back are correct.
note: Also: p = 0.1 + 0.2 evaluates to 0.30000000000000004 in the segment chance pipeline (roll exactly 0.3 slays); negligible, noted only.
fix: src/engine/skills/curated/batch-r28.ts 10061: execute(chosenStat armor) before damage and pull-back (R001)

clause: c3 'If they are a Tower, deal 3x - 5x damage, based on my Ascensions.'
step: native step 4 Damage StatusModifier MultiplyForAscensionCastle StatusAmount 3

actual: Runtime modifier ratio a=3 b=1 on lastReduce: floor(50/3)=16 -> 30. Values agree for armor < 50 and diverge from 50 upward (e.g. 50,53,56,...).

Community-level source only; kept current implementation. Affects every [3:1] spell whose native Count step has Amount 34.
